_comment: Curated fallback ideas, filtered by event_type and budget_tier (comfortable|workable|tight|unrealistic).

themes.name: Garden Romance
themes.description: A lush, floral celebration with softly draped fabric, abundant greenery, and warm candlelight that transforms any venue into an enchanted garden.

themes.name: Timeless Elegance
themes.description: Classic black-tie with monochrome sophistication, statement florals, and clean architectural lines — a look that photographs beautifully decades later.

themes.name: Bohemian Sunset
themes.description: Free-spirited and warm, with rattan furniture, pampas grass, macramé accents, and a golden-hour colour palette.

activities: Cocktail hour with live acoustic music or a string quartet
Personalised wedding quiz during the drinks reception
Polaroid photo booth with custom frames
Lawn games (croquet, giant Jenga) for outdoor receptions
Signature cocktail named after the couple
menu_suggestions: Three-course plated dinner with a vegetarian option for every course
Grazing table with artisan cheeses, charcuterie, and seasonal fruits for cocktail hour
Dessert station with miniature pastries, macarons, and individual wedding cakes
Midnight snack: sliders or stone-baked mini pizzas
Mocktail bar with zero-alcohol alternatives throughout
decor_ideas: Statement suspended floral cloud above the head table
Pillar candles of varying heights on mirrored trays as centrepieces
Personalised menus and place cards with calligraphy
Softbox fairy-light curtain as a photogenic backdrop
Herb-and-flower table runners that guests can take home
music_vibes: String quartet for the ceremony and cocktail hour
Live band for the reception — jazz → pop → dance progression
Curated playlist: Frank Sinatra to Beyoncé for the dinner hour
First dance: a meaningful song, optionally with a DJ mashup reveal
comfortable.sample_invitation: Together with their families, [Name] and [Name] joyfully invite you to celebrate their marriage on [Date] at [Venue]. Dinner, dancing, and an evening to remember await. Kindly reply by [RSVP Date].
money_saving_ideas: Book a Friday or Sunday — venues often charge 20–30% less than Saturday
Choose flowers in season — ask your florist for what's abundant in your wedding month
Limit the bar to wine, beer, and one signature cocktail rather than a full open bar
Serve a dessert table instead of individual plated desserts to reduce kitchen labour
accessibility_touches: Reserve front-row seats for guests with mobility needs
Provide large-print or digital menu cards
Ensure the dance floor has a smooth, firm surface
Arrange a quiet breakout room for guests who need a calm space

themes.name: Rustic Charm
themes.description: Wooden accents, mason jars, wildflowers, and warm string lights create an intimate atmosphere with a lot of DIY personality.

themes.name: Modern Minimalist
themes.description: Clean lines, single-variety floral arrangements, and a restrained colour palette that looks expensive without the price tag.

activities: Self-service Polaroid station with a prop basket
Lawn games if the venue allows
Wedding bingo cards on each seat for the ceremony
menu_suggestions: Buffet service — reduces plated service staff costs significantly
Family-style sharing platters for a convivial atmosphere
DIY taco or pasta bar — crowd-pleasing and cost-effective
Cake and coffee station rather than a full dessert menu
decor_ideas: DIY centrepieces with bud vases, candles, and greenery
Foliage garlands from a wholesale market to dress tables and arches
Paper flower backdrop — striking visual with modest material cost
Battery-powered fairy lights — no need for an electrician
music_vibes: DJ for the full reception — versatile and cost-effective
Curated Spotify playlist for ceremony and dinner
Encourage guests to suggest songs via a digital request form
workable.sample_invitation: [Name] & [Name] would love you to join them as they say 'I do' on [Date] at [Venue]. Celebrations follow. Please RSVP by [RSVP Date].
money_saving_ideas: DIY your invitations and order of service using Canva
Hire student musicians from a local music college — great talent, lower cost
Use potted plants as centrepieces that guests can take home
Choose a venue that allows outside catering
accessibility_touches: Clearly mark accessible parking and entrances on the map you send guests
Check that the venue has accessible bathrooms and confirm with the coordinator

themes.name: Intimate Garden Party
themes.description: A small, heartfelt celebration in a garden or park with close family and friends — the intimacy makes it special.

activities: Shared meal with toasts from loved ones
menu_suggestions: Home-cooked feast with contributions from family — meaningful and personal
Catered buffet for essential dishes, home-made extras
Wedding cake as the main dessert
decor_ideas: Flowers from a farmers' market arranged at home
Candles and fairy lights for warm ambience
Personalised signage printed at home
music_vibes: Curated playlist on a Bluetooth speaker
Open mic moment for musical friends
tight.sample_invitation: We're getting married! Please join us on [Date] at [Venue] for an intimate celebration. RSVP by [RSVP Date].
money_saving_ideas: Keep the guest list small — per-head cost is the biggest driver
Marry on a weekday — venues are considerably cheaper
Opt for a civil ceremony and a restaurant lunch rather than a full venue hire
Borrow or rent decor from a wedding hire company
accessibility_touches: Ensure your chosen venue is accessible before booking
Ask guests to note any requirements when they RSVP

themes.name: Micro-Wedding
themes.description: A very intimate celebration with just immediate family. Quality over quantity — focus on one beautiful element rather than many.

menu_suggestions: Restaurant dinner for close family
Home-cooked celebration meal
decor_ideas: Single statement floral arrangement
Candles and personal photos
music_vibes: Meaningful playlist on a phone speaker
unrealistic.sample_invitation: We'd love to share this moment with you. Join us on [Date] for a small, meaningful celebration.
money_saving_ideas: Consider elopement with a dinner party afterwards
A register office ceremony costs a fraction of a venue hire
Celebrate with a larger party later when budget allows
accessibility_touches: Choose a venue that's fully accessible from the outset

themes.name: Tropical Fiesta
themes.description: Vibrant tropical flowers, rattan furniture, tiki elements, and bold colours transport guests to a beachside paradise.

themes.name: Glamour & Gold
themes.description: Black-and-gold luxury with sequined backdrops, champagne towers, and velvet-ribbon details for a milestone birthday.

activities: Live DJ or band for dancing
Personalised trivia quiz about the birthday person
Cooking station or interactive food activity
menu_suggestions: Grazing table for arrival — cheese, charcuterie, mezze
Sharing feast with multiple cuisines to cater to dietary variety
Custom birthday cake as a centrepiece moment
Dessert table with macarons, truffles, and themed sweets
Signature birthday cocktail and a mocktail alternative
decor_ideas: Balloon arch or ceiling installation in theme colours
Personalised banner with milestone age
Floral centrepieces with theme-coloured blooms
Neon sign with a fun birthday message
Photo wall with memories of the birthday person's life
music_vibes: Spotify playlist built around the birthday person's favourite decades
Live DJ for the dancing portion
Surprise live performance if budget allows
comfortable.sample_invitation: You're invited to celebrate [Name]'s [Age] birthday! Join us for an unforgettable evening on [Date] at [Venue]. RSVP by [RSVP Date] — the more the merrier!
money_saving_ideas: Host on a Sunday — venue hire is typically lower
Choose a restaurant buyout for smaller gatherings — saves on venue setup
Potluck dessert table where guests contribute a dish
accessibility_touches: Provide seating throughout (not just around tables) so guests with mobility needs can rest
Designate a quieter area away from the DJ for conversations

themes.name: Garden Party
themes.description: Relaxed outdoor gathering with floral tablecloths, bunting, and seasonal flowers. Works beautifully in a garden or park.

themes.name: Movie Night
themes.description: Outdoor or indoor cinema experience with blankets, popcorn, and a favourite film — personal and cosy.

menu_suggestions: BBQ or buffet — cost-effective and social
Afternoon tea style spread — sandwiches, scones, cakes
Pizza party — universally popular
decor_ideas: DIY balloon garland using a pump and string
Photo bunting from printed favourite memories
Mason jar centrepieces with seasonal flowers
music_vibes: DJ playlist on Spotify via a good Bluetooth speaker
Live acoustic guitarist for background ambience
workable.sample_invitation: It's [Name]'s birthday and we're celebrating! Come join us on [Date] at [Venue]. Drinks, food, and fun guaranteed. RSVP by [RSVP Date].
money_saving_ideas: Host at home or in a community hall to save venue costs
Bake the birthday cake yourself or ask a talented friend
Buy decorations from a pound/dollar store and add personal touches
accessibility_touches: Ensure garden paths are firm and flat if hosting outdoors
Offer quieter seating away from speakers

themes.name: Backyard BBQ
themes.description: Relaxed, fun, and completely focused on good food and good people. The original budget celebration.

activities: Storytelling round — favourite memory of the birthday person
menu_suggestions: DIY BBQ with guests contributing side dishes
Homemade birthday cake — often more sentimental
BYO drinks policy to keep costs manageable
decor_ideas: Homemade bunting from fabric scraps
Colourful paper plates and cups from a discount store
Photos on a string across the garden
music_vibes: Phone playlist through a Bluetooth speaker
tight.sample_invitation: Come celebrate [Name]'s birthday on [Date] at [Address]. Bring something to BBQ and something to drink!
money_saving_ideas: Potluck format — ask guests to each bring a dish
Skip the venue and use your garden or a friend's space
Digital invitations save on print and postage
accessibility_touches: Check the outdoor space is suitable for any guests with mobility requirements

themes.name: Cosy Kitchen Party
themes.description: Small group of close friends or family, home-cooked food, and genuine celebration — often the most memorable kind.

menu_suggestions: Home-cooked favourite meal
Shop-bought birthday cake
decor_ideas: A few balloons
Candles on the table
music_vibes: Playlist on a phone
unrealistic.sample_invitation: Come over for [Name]'s birthday on [Date]! Just good food and good company.
money_saving_ideas: Focus on 1–2 meaningful touches rather than trying to do everything
A heartfelt handwritten card is often more valued than a gift
accessibility_touches: Ensure your home is accessible for all guests you invite

themes.name: Community Fair
themes.description: A vibrant outdoor fair with stalls, live entertainment, and activities for all ages — the quintessential community celebration.

themes.name: Cultural Festival
themes.description: A rich celebration of local heritage with traditional food stalls, music, art, and storytelling that brings diverse communities together.

activities: Live music stage with local acts
Arts and crafts workshops for children and adults
Community photo display or heritage exhibition
Traditional games from the local culture
menu_suggestions: Multiple food stalls representing local cuisines
Dedicated vegan and gluten-free stalls
Local brew or soft drink bar
Dedicated children's food area with simple, allergen-aware options
decor_ideas: Colourful bunting and flags down main pathways
Local artwork displayed around the venue
Interactive community message board where attendees add notes
Signage in multiple languages reflecting the community
music_vibes: Local bands and performers across the day
Open mic sessions to showcase community talent
Background world music playlist between live acts
comfortable.sample_invitation: Join us for [Event Name] on [Date] at [Venue]! A day of food, music, and community spirit. Free entry. All are welcome.
money_saving_ideas: Partner with local businesses for sponsorship in exchange for a stall or banner
Recruit volunteers rather than paid staff for stewarding
Apply for community grants — many local councils and charities fund public events
accessibility_touches: Publish a detailed accessibility guide on all promotional materials
Provide a quiet zone away from the main stage
Arrange BSL interpretation for stage presentations
Designate priority viewing areas near the stage

themes.name: Street Party
themes.description: Classic neighbourhood celebration on a closed-off street with bunting, trestle tables, and a joyful community spirit.
palette: union flag colours or local equivalent

activities: Egg-and-spoon and sack races for children
Cake stall and tombola to raise funds
menu_suggestions: Potluck format — residents bring dishes to share
Donated or sponsored food stalls
BBQ with simple burger and sausage options
decor_ideas: Homemade bunting made at a community workshop beforehand
Tables decorated by local school children
Balloons and flowers from a local wholesaler
music_vibes: Local band or DJ
Community choir performance
PA system for announcements and playlist
workable.sample_invitation: You're invited to [Event Name] on [Date] — [Venue/Street Name]. Free for all residents. Bring a dish to share!
money_saving_ideas: Apply for a street party licence — often free for small community events
Source donated prizes for raffles and tombolas
Partner with a local supermarket to sponsor refreshments
accessibility_touches: Ensure road surface is accessible for wheelchairs
Provide shaded and seating areas throughout

themes.name: Community Gathering
themes.description: A simple, purposeful gathering focused on connection and shared goals rather than elaborate production.

menu_suggestions: Potluck contributions from attendees
Sponsored refreshments from local businesses
Simple tea and coffee station
decor_ideas: Printed signage and posters
Community noticeboard as a centrepiece
Volunteer-made decorations
music_vibes: Local musician volunteering their time
Curated playlist via a phone and speaker
tight.sample_invitation: Join us for [Event Name] on [Date] at [Venue]. Come together and celebrate our community!
money_saving_ideas: Use a community centre or library — often free or low-cost for community groups
Ask local businesses to donate refreshments in exchange for a mention
Recruit volunteers for all stewarding and setup roles
accessibility_touches: Choose an accessible venue as the top priority
Use plain-language communications in all promotional materials

themes.name: Pop-Up Community Hub
themes.description: A minimal, volunteer-led event in a community space that focuses on connection and conversation over production value.

menu_suggestions: Tea and biscuits
Donated refreshments
decor_ideas: Printed posters
Volunteer-made banner
music_vibes: Acoustic volunteer performer
unrealistic.sample_invitation: You are warmly invited to join [Event Name] on [Date] at [Venue]. Free to attend.
money_saving_ideas: Focus on one central activity rather than spreading the budget thin
Apply for emergency community grants
Partner with a local charity who may have an existing budget
accessibility_touches: Accessible venue is non-negotiable even on the tightest budget
